summary: Completed frontend-only validation of /supplier-assessment/ranking Supplier Sustainability Risk Matrix at public preview URL using admin login. Targeted matrix, legend, color-zone semantics, tooltip content, and viewport overflow checks passed.

issues: Console shows repeated Recharts warnings ('width(-1) and height(-1) should be greater than 0') during page render; visible UI still renders but noisy runtime warnings remain.

action_items: Optionally address Recharts container sizing warnings in overview render path to keep console clean.
Retest this route after any future changes to matrix layout or grouping logic.
critical_code_review_comments: Risk grouping implementation in buildRiskMatrix aligns with requested semantics: high-emission/high-ESG => priority, high-emission/low-ESG => critical, low-emission/high-ESG => strategic, low-emission/low-ESG => developing.
Frontend API URL usage is environment-based (process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) and no hardcoded backend URL was found in reviewed ranking files.
All matrix interactive points and key matrix/legend blocks include data-testid attributes, supporting stable UI automation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Used admin credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Route redirects to /login when unauthenticated; post-login navigation to /supplier-assessment/ranking succeeds. Matrix rendered with four zones + right legend, dot tooltip displayed supplier name/ESG/emissions, and no horizontal overflow at 1920x800.
rca of the issue: No functional regression found for requested matrix refinement items.
